00003 void smatrix_dspmv( smatrix_t *mat_in, dvector_t *vec_in, dvector_t *vec_out )
00004 {
00005         long int i,j;
00006 
00007         for(i=0;i<mat_in->nrows;i++)
00008         {
00009                 vec_out->start[i*vec_out->rsize] = 0.0;
00010                 for(j=0;j<mat_in->lvec[i];j++)
00011                         vec_out->start[i*vec_out->rsize] += vec_in->start[mat_in->jvec[i][j]*vec_in->rsize] * mat_in->mvec[i][j];
00012         }
00013 }

00049 void smatrix_lin_com( double cof1_in, smatrix_t *mat1_in, long int col1_in, double cof2_in, smatrix_t *mat2_in, long int col2_in, smatrix_t *mat_out, long int col_out )
00050 {
00051         long int i,j;
00052         double ent1,ent2,tmp;
00053         assert( mat1_in->nrows == mat2_in->nrows && mat2_in->nrows == mat_out->nrows );
00054         for(i=0;i<mat1_in->nrows;i++)
00055         {
00056                 smatrix_entry( mat1_in, i, col1_in, &ent1 );
00057                 smatrix_entry( mat2_in, i, col2_in, &ent2 );
00058                 tmp = cof1_in * ent1 + cof2_in * ent2;
00059                 smatrix_insert( mat_out, i, col_out, tmp );
00060         }
00061 }

00099 void smatrix_dsplud( smatrix_t *mat_in )
00100 {
00101         long int i,j,k,m,idx,jdx,its,dx1,dx2;
00102         double xi,xk,tau,m1,m2;
00103         for(i=0;i<mat_in->ncols-1;i++)
00104         {
00105                 smatrix_entry( mat_in, i, i, &xk );
00106                 if( fabs(xk) < SMATRIX_ZERO_THRESHOLD )
00107                 {
00108                         printf( "smatrix_dsplud(): zero on the diagonal at (%d,%d) = %f\n", i, i, xk );
00109                         exit(0);
00110                 }
00111                 for(j=i+1;j<mat_in->nrows;j++) // (j,j) is entry multiplied by unity
00112                 {
00113                         smatrix_entry( mat_in, j, i, &xi );
00114                         tau = xi / xk;
00115                         smatrix_insert( mat_in, j, i, tau );
00116                         binary_closest( &i, mat_in->jvec[j], &mat_in->lvec[j], &jdx, &its );
00117                         binary_closest( &i, mat_in->jvec[i], &mat_in->lvec[i], &idx, &its );
00118                         for(k=jdx+1,m=idx+1;;)
00119                         {
00120                                 m1 = 0.0; m2 = 0.0;
00121                                 dx1 = -1; dx2 = -1;
00122                                 if( k >= mat_in->lvec[j] && m >= mat_in->lvec[i] )
00123                                         break;
00124                                 if( k < mat_in->lvec[j] )
00125                                 {
00126                                         dx1 = mat_in->jvec[j][k];
00127                                         m1 = mat_in->mvec[j][k];
00128                                 }
00129                                 if( m < mat_in->lvec[i] )
00130                                 {
00131                                         dx2 = mat_in->jvec[i][m];
00132                                         m2 = mat_in->mvec[i][m];
00133                                 }
00134                                 if( dx1 != -1 && dx2 != -1 )
00135                                 {
00136                                         if( dx1 == dx2 )
00137                                         {
00138                                                 mat_in->mvec[j][k] = m1 - tau * m2; // j,[k] entry guaranteed to exist
00139                                                 ++k,++m;
00140                                         }
00141                                         else
00142                                         {
00143                                                 if( dx1 < dx2 )
00144                                                         ++k;
00145                                                 else
00146                                                 {
00147                                                         smatrix_insert( mat_in, j, dx2, -1.0 * tau * m2 );
00148                                                         ++m;
00149                                                 }
00150                                         }
00151                                 }
00152                                 else
00153                                 {
00154                                         if( dx1 > -1 ) // But dx2 is not
00155                                                 ++k;
00156                                         else
00157                                         {
00158                                                 if( dx2 > -1 ) // But dx1 is not
00159                                                 {
00160                                                         smatrix_insert( mat_in, j, dx2, -1.0 * tau * m2 );
00161                                                         ++m,++k;
00162                                                 }
00163                                                 else // REACHING HERE IS A BUG
00164                                                         printf( "smatrix_dsplud(): both indices i, j out of range; THIS IS BUG\n" );
00165                                         }
00166                                 }
00167                         }
00168                 }
00169         }
00170 }

00362 void smatrix_darkrd_sparse_inv_prod( int n_in, smatrix_t *lud_in, smatrix_t *rhm_in, dvector_t *b_in, smatrix_t *Q_in, smatrix_t *H_in )
00363 {
00364         int i,j,k;
00365         double sum,tmp;
00366 
00367         /* Copy b_in into first column of Q_in */
00368         sum = 0.0;
00369         for(i=0;i<b_in->length;i++)
00370                 sum += b_in->start[i] * b_in->start[i];
00371         sum = sqrt( sum );
00372         for(i=0;i<b_in->length;i++)
00373                 smatrix_insert( Q_in, i, 0, b_in->start[i] / sum );
00374 
00375         /* Subtract one from n_in to make basis of correct size */
00376         --n_in;
00377 
00378         /* Outer loop - Matrix-vector multiplication in Q */
00379         for(i=0;i<n_in;i++)
00380         {
00381                 smatrix_dspmv_sparse( rhm_in, Q_in, i, Q_in, i + 1 );
00382                 smatrix_dspfbs_size( lud_in, Q_in, i + 1, 1 );
00383                 for(j=0;j<=i;j++)
00384                 {
00385                         tmp = smatrix_col_dot_prod( Q_in, j, Q_in, i + 1 );
00386                         smatrix_lin_com( -1.0 * tmp, Q_in, j, 1.0, Q_in, i + 1, Q_in, i + 1 );
00387                         smatrix_insert( H_in, j, i, tmp );
00388                 }
00389                 sum = smatrix_col_dot_prod( Q_in, i + 1, Q_in, i + 1 );
00390                 sum = sqrt( sum );
00391                 smatrix_insert( H_in, j, i, sum );
00392                 for(k=0;k<Q_in->nrows;k++)
00393                 {
00394                         smatrix_entry( Q_in, k, i + 1, &tmp );
00395                         smatrix_insert( Q_in, k, i + 1, tmp / sum );
00396                 }
00397         }
00398 
00399         /* Create final column in H */
00400         smatrix_dspmv_sparse_dvector( rhm_in, Q_in, n_in, b_in );
00401         smatrix_dspfbs_dvector( lud_in, b_in );
00402         for(i=0;i<=n_in;i++)
00403         {
00404                 tmp = smatrix_col_dot_prod_dvector( Q_in, i, b_in );
00405                 smatrix_insert( H_in, i, n_in, tmp );
00406         }
00407 }
